description: 🚀 Nebuvita is a team passionate about AI, Data Science, Engineering, and space exploration.
summary:
Space missions come with challenges that go far beyond reaching new destinations. Astronauts live in an environment where even small changes in their health can matter, and getting medical help from Earth is not always possible. That's why we developed TRUSTLINE.
TRUSTLINE is an AI-powered platform designed to help monitor astronaut health and make sense of the data collected during missions. It brings together health sensors, machine learning, medical documents, and specialized AI agents to analyze health signals, detect unusual patterns, and provide useful insights.
The platform also features a 3D human digital twin to visualize health data, an interactive dashboard, and a hybrid AI system that can continue supporting operations when communication with Earth is limited.
Our goal is simple: give astronauts and medical teams a clearer picture of what's happening, help them make better-informed decisions, and make health monitoring more reliable in one of the most challenging environments humans can explore.
details:
TRUSTLINE — Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring & Decision Support

TRUSTLINE is a research prototype designed to make astronaut health monitoring smarter, more connected, and more reliable during space missions. Our idea is to bring physiological data, medical knowledge, and AI-powered analysis together in one platform, helping astronauts and medical teams better understand changes in health conditions, especially when communication with Earth is limited.

How does it work?

TRUSTLINE collects and processes physiological signals such as heart rate, ECG, blood oxygen, skin temperature, respiration, EDA, and movement data. Its processing pipeline checks sensor quality before the data is used for further analysis.

The platform uses three specialized AI agents:

  • Sensor Quality Agent: Evaluates incoming signals and identifies missing, noisy, or potentially unreliable measurements.
  • Personal Health Agent: Analyzes health data in relation to an astronaut's personal baseline.
  • Risk Assessment Agent: Combines available evidence to identify potential concerns and support informed decisions.

A LangGraph Supervisor coordinates these agents. The system also includes machine learning for anomaly detection, medical document processing, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), allowing relevant information to be retrieved from medical documents and presented with supporting evidence.

Benefits and intended impact

Our goal is to help astronauts and medical teams move beyond simply viewing sensor readings. TRUSTLINE aims to turn complex health data into clearer, evidence-supported insights. Its hybrid AI architecture is designed to support local processing and fallback capabilities when cloud services or communication with Earth become unavailable.

The platform also incorporates a 3D human digital twin concept to make physiological information easier to understand and connect different measurements to their corresponding body locations.

Technology and tools

We developed the AI and data-processing components primarily using Python, alongside FastAPI for backend services. Our technology stack includes:

  • AI and orchestration: LangGraph, LangChain, and specialized AI agents.
  • AI models and providers: Groq API, Hugging Face Inference API, and Ollama for local model execution.
  • Machine Learning: Scikit-learn and the WESAD dataset for physiological signal analysis and experimentation.
  • Medical intelligence: Groq Vision for document OCR and medical RAG pipelines.
  • Data and persistence: Structured data processing, SQLite-based storage, and evidence tracking.
  • Testing: Automated tests, regression testing, and simulated sensor scenarios.

Development and testing were carried out using an Apple Silicon Mac, with simulated physiological sensor data used to experiment with different conditions and system responses.

What makes TRUSTLINE creative?

What makes TRUSTLINE different is the way it combines multiple technologies into one health-monitoring workflow rather than relying on a single AI model. It connects signal-quality validation, personal health baselines, risk assessment, medical knowledge retrieval, and hybrid AI execution.

We also considered several important factors: limited communication with Earth, unreliable sensor readings, individual differences between astronauts, data privacy, uncertainty in AI-generated insights, and the importance of keeping simulated data separate from operational health information.

Ultimately, TRUSTLINE is built around one important idea: when astronauts are millions of kilometers away from Earth, understanding their health should never depend on a single data source, a single model, or a constant internet connection.

TRUSTLINE is a research prototype and is not clinically validated or approved for medical use.
